errors.text_span: 图表中有两组并排的柱状图
errors.evidence: The chart contains three groups of bars, not two. Each group corresponds to one of the three categories on the x-axis: '近' (Near), '中' (Mid), and '远' (Far).
In the '远' (Far) category, the bar values are approximately 58.9% and 56.2%, not 58.2% and 55.6%. The reported value of 55.6% is particularly inaccurate as the bar is clearly above the 56% tick mark.

The description fails to map the visual patterns of the bars to the methods they represent. It states they use a striped pattern to differentiate but does not specify that '本文方法' is a white bar with stripes and '基线模型' is a grey bar with stripes, as shown in the legend.
In the '近' (Near) category, the F1 value for '本文方法' is approximately 59.4%, not 59.2%.
In the '近' (Near) category, the F1 value for '基线模型' is approximately 59.0%, not 58.8%.
In the '中' (Mid) category, the F1 value for '本文方法' is approximately 59.2%, not 59.0%.
In the '中' (Mid) category, the F1 value for '基线模型' is approximately 58.7%, not 58.4%.
